scope: OpenVINS native image/IMU estimator replay, CPU baseline, no viewer, no ROS DDS transport, no physical camera or IMU capture
algorithm_config: upstream config/euroc_mav; stereo 752x480 at 20 Hz, IMU 200 Hz, 200 points per camera, 11 clones, 50 SLAM features, online camera calibration and time offset enabled
initialization: natural inertial/visual initialization; no ground truth initialization; full sequence from timestamp zero with no initial skip
paced_policy: single sequential worker with sleep-until absolute sensor-release schedule; no intentional frame drops; lag measured from scheduled camera timestamp to completion including image load/decode and IMU lookahead; not physical exposure or ROS enqueue latency
clock_policy: existing schedutil governor retained, default inherited CPU affinity 0-7; sampled clock frequencies retained; no clock or thermal-policy changes

background_work.MH_01_easy-paced-1: V2 mirror download and archive hashing overlapped
background_work.V2_02_medium-all: no concurrent dataset preparation; estimator runs sequentially

limitations: MH unpaced results are exploratory throughput under recorded background download
MH first two paced runs include data preparation load; do not aggregate them with the final paced run as controlled repeats
other host processes may still exist; host-workload.txt is a snapshot
fixed offline calibration is EuRoC, not SC132GS/ICM-42688 hardware calibration
ROS2 active-input background-publisher lifecycle remains untested
input FPS is not the rate of valid poses before initialization
